assets.prompt: Create ONE educational illustration, a separate cutout asset. Fine charcoal ink contours with restrained layered watercolour and realistic object/anatomy proportions. Keep roughly 12% clear transparent margins on every side. No people, human hands, human faces, brands or labels. Include text, numbers or arrows only if the individual asset brief explicitly requires them. Animal heads are essential where appropriate. Preserve the requested view and approximate aspect ratio. No cast shadow or floor unless explicitly requested. ASSET BRIEF: 1. `hms-bedside-phone-alarm-v1.png` (2000 x 1400): a bedside table in a dark bedroom at night, a face-up smartphone whose screen glows with a plain blank light (no interface, no text), and a round analogue alarm clock with its hands at 6.30 (no numerals needed; tick marks only). A corner of a pillow and blanket may show at the edge. Cool night palette with the screen as the only warm light. No people, hands or faces anywhere in the image; the screen shows no faces and no real app branding; no brand.
